lead: These are the daily work rules. Please keep to the deadlines for reports and requests so that records are correct.

s1.title: Submitting and editing daily reports and expenses
s1.r1: {b} (today, yesterday, or the day before yesterday).
s1.r1b: You can submit or edit only within the last 3 days, including today
s1.r2: Older dates are {b}. This applies to both daily reports and expenses.
s1.r2b: locked and cannot be submitted or edited
s1.r3: If you must fix a day after the deadline, {b}. If allowed, you can enter that day again.
s1.r4: You will get a reminder if you have not submitted. Please submit early.

s2.title: Overtime requests
s2.r1b: send an overtime request by 16:00 the same day
s2.r2: Use {b} in the menu. Enter the end time you want and the reason, then send it. When an admin approves it, you can enter an end time later than the normal end time for that day only.
s2.r3b: you cannot enter times after the normal end time

s3.title: Working hours
s3.r1b: based on the start and end times set for each site by the person in charge
s3.r2: If your hours change for a special reason, such as an early morning delivery, send an overtime request.

s4.title: Checking in and out
s4.r1: {b} at the site. Do not forget.
s4.r1b: You must check in when you arrive and check out when you leave
s4.r2: To check in or out, {b1}, or use {b2} in the menu.
s4.r3: If the site has no QR code, {b} to check in or out (you can filter by main contractor or site name).
s4.r4: At sites with a checklist, check each item when you check in or out.

note: * These rules may be updated. Please check this page for the latest version.
